<SEQUENCE>2
<FILENAME>dex41a.htm
<DESCRIPTION>FIRST AMENDMENT TO RIGHTS AGREEMENT
<TEXT>
<HTML><HEAD>
<TITLE>First Amendment to Rights Agreement</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Exhibit 4.1(a) </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>FIRST AMENDMENT TO RIGHTS AGREEMENT </U></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">AMENDMENT dated as of April&nbsp;12, 2006 (this
&#147;<U>Amendment</U>&#148;), to the Rights Agreement dated as of December&nbsp;8, 2000 (the &#147;<U>Rights Agreement</U>&#148;), between Sybron Dental Specialties, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the &#147;<U>Company</U>&#148;) and Computershare
Trust Company, N.A. (formerly known as EquiServe Trust Company, N.A.), a national banking association, as Rights Agent (the &#147;<U>Rights Agent</U>&#148;). Terms used but not defined herein shall have the meanings assigned to them in the Rights
Agreement. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, the Company proposes to enter into an Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of April&nbsp;12, 2006 (as amended from
time to time, the &#147;Merger Agreement&#148;), by and among Danaher Corporation, a Delaware corporation (&#147;<U>Parent</U>&#148;), Smile Acquisition Corp., a Delaware corporation and a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent, and the Company;
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, pursuant to the Merger Agreement the Parent has agreed to cause Smile Acquisition Corp. to commence a tender offer (as it may be
amended from time to time in accordance with the Merger Agreement, the &#147;Offer&#148;) to purchase all of the Company&#146;s common stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &#147;Common Shares&#148;), including the associated preferred share
purchase rights (the &#147;Rights&#148;) issued pursuant to the Rights Agreement; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, the Board of Directors of the Company has
determined that the Merger Agreement and the terms and conditions set forth therein and the transactions contemplated thereby, including, without limitation, the Offer and the Merger (as such term is defined in the Merger Agreement), are advisable
and are fair to and in the best interests of the Company and its stockholders; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, the Board of Directors of the Company has
determined, in connection with the execution of the Merger Agreement, that it is desirable to amend the Rights Agreement to exempt the Merger Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereby, including, without limitation, the Offer and the
Merger, from the application of the Rights Agreement as set forth in this Amendment; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, Section&nbsp;27 of the Rights Agreement
provides that, prior to the Distribution Date (as defined in the Rights Agreement), the Company and the Rights Agent shall, if the Company so directs, supplement or amend any provision of the Rights Agreement without the approval of any holders of
certificates representing shares of Common Stock of the Company upon delivery of a certificate from an appropriate officer of the Company which states that the proposed supplement or amendment is in compliance with the terms of Section&nbsp;27 of
the Rights Agreement, provided that the Rights Agreement may not be amended at a time when the Rights (as defined in the Rights Agreement) are not redeemable; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, there has been no such Distribution Date as of the time immediately prior to this Amendment, and the Rights are redeemable as of the date of this Amendment; and </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, pursuant to the terms of the Rights Agreement and in accordance with Section&nbsp;27 thereof,
the Company has directed that the Rights Agreement should be amended as set forth in this Amendment prior to the execution of the Merger Agreement and has delivered a certificate that this Amendment is in compliance with the terms of Section&nbsp;27
of the Rights Agreement. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the mutual agreements herein set forth, the parties hereby
agree as follows: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Section 1. <U>Amendments to Rights Agreement</U>. The Rights Agreement is hereby amended as follows: </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) The definition of &#147;Acquiring Person&#148; in Section&nbsp;1(a) of the Rights Agreement is amended by inserting the following new sentence at the
end of such definition: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, none of Danaher Corporation,
Smile Acquisition Corp. or any Affiliate or Associate of either shall be deemed to be an Acquiring Person or a Beneficial Owner of Common Stock, either individually or collectively, solely as a result of (i)&nbsp;the approval, execution, delivery,
announcement or performance of the Merger Agreement; (ii)&nbsp;the commencement or consummation of the Offer; or (iii)&nbsp;the consummation of the Merger or any of the other transactions contemplated in the Merger Agreement.&#148; </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b) The definition of &#147;Stock Acquisition Date&#148; in Section&nbsp;1(dd) of the Rights Agreement is amended to add the following sentence at the
end thereof: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, a Stock Acquisition Date shall not be deemed
to have occurred solely as a result of (i)&nbsp;the approval, execution, delivery, announcement or performance of the Merger Agreement; (ii)&nbsp;the commencement or consummation of the Offer; or (iii)&nbsp;the consummation of the Merger or any of
the other transactions contemplated in the Merger Agreement.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(c) The definition of &#147;Triggering Event&#148; in
Section&nbsp;1(ii) of the Rights Agreement is amended to add the following sentence at the end thereof: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">&#147;Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, a Triggering Event shall not be deemed to have occurred solely as a result of (i)&nbsp;the approval, execution, delivery, announcement or performance of the Merger Agreement;
(ii)&nbsp;the commencement or consummation of the Offer; or (iii)&nbsp;the consummation of the Merger or any of the other transactions contemplated in the Merger Agreement.&#148; </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(d) The following definitions are added to Section&nbsp;1 of the Rights Agreement: </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;(jj) &#145;Merger&#146; shall mean the merger of Smile Acquisition Corp. with and into the Company, in accordance with the terms and
conditions of the Merger Agreement. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">2 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(kk) &#145;Merger Agreement&#146; shall mean the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated as of
April&nbsp;12, 2006 by and among Danaher Corporation, Smile Acquisition Corp. and the Company, as amended from time to time. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">(ll) &#145;Offer&#146; shall mean the tender offer by Smile Acquisition Corp. commenced pursuant to the Merger Agreement.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">(e) Section&nbsp;3(a) of the Rights Agreement is amended to add the following sentence at the end thereof: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">&#147;Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, a Distribution Date shall not be deemed to have occurred solely as the result of (i)&nbsp;the approval, execution, delivery, announcement or performance of the Merger
Agreement; (ii)&nbsp;the commencement or consummation of the Offer; or (iii)&nbsp;the consummation of the Merger or any of the other transactions contemplated in the Merger Agreement.&#148; </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(f) Section&nbsp;7(a) of the Rights Agreement is modified, amended and restated in its entirety as follows: </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;Subject to Section&nbsp;7(e) hereof, at any time after the Distribution Date, the registered holder of any Rights Certificate may
exercise the Rights evidenced thereby (except as otherwise provided herein including, without limitation, the restrictions on exercisability set forth in Section&nbsp;9(c), Section&nbsp;11(a)(iii) and Section&nbsp;23(a) hereof) in whole or in part
upon surrender of the Rights Certificate, with the form of election to purchase and the certificate on the reverse side thereof duly executed, to the Rights Agent at the principal office or offices of the Rights Agent designated for such purpose,
together with payment of the aggregate Purchase Price with respect to the total number of one one-hundredths of a share (or other securities, cash or other asserts, as the case may be) as to which such surrendered Rights are then exercisable, at or
prior to the earliest of (i)&nbsp;the time immediately prior to the Effective Time (as such term is defined in the Merger Agreement), (ii)&nbsp;5:00 P.M., New York City time, on December&nbsp;11, 2010, or such later date as may be established by the
Board of Directors prior to the expiration of the Rights (such date, as it may be extended by the Board (the &#145;Final Expiration Date&#146;), or (iii)&nbsp;the time at which the Rights are redeemed or exchanged as provided in Section&nbsp;23 or
Section&nbsp;24 hereof (the earliest of (i), (ii)&nbsp;and (iii)&nbsp;being herein referred to as the &#145;Expiration Date&#146;).&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">(g) Section&nbsp;11(a)(ii) of the Rights Agreement is amended to add the following at the end thereof immediately prior to the period: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;; provided, however, that, notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, a Section&nbsp;11(a)(ii) Event shall not be deemed to have occurred solely as a result of (A)&nbsp;the approval, execution,
delivery, announcement or performance of the Merger Agreement; (B)&nbsp;the commencement or consummation of the Offer; or (C)&nbsp;the consummation of the Merger or any of the other transactions contemplated in the Merger Agreement.&#148;
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">3 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(h) Section&nbsp;13(a) of the Rights Agreement is amended to add the following at the end thereof
immediately prior to the period: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;; provided, however, that, notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the
contrary, a Section&nbsp;13 Event shall not be deemed to have occurred solely as a result of (i)&nbsp;the approval, execution, delivery, announcement or performance of the Merger Agreement; (ii)&nbsp;the commencement or consummation of the Offer; or
(iii)&nbsp;the consummation of the Merger or any of the other transactions contemplated in the Merger Agreement.&#148; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(i) Section&nbsp;25
of the Rights Agreement is amended to add the following new section at the end thereof: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;(c) Notwithstanding anything
in this Agreement to the contrary, the Company shall not be required to give any notice hereunder to any holder of a Rights Certificate solely as a result of (i)&nbsp;the approval, execution, delivery, announcement or performance of the Merger
Agreement; (ii)&nbsp;the commencement or consummation of the Offer; or (iii)&nbsp;the consummation of the Merger or any of the other transactions contemplated in the Merger Agreement.&#148; </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(j) A new Section&nbsp;35 with the heading &#147;<U>Termination at the Effective Time</U>&#148; is hereby added to the Rights Agreement reading in its
entirety as follows: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;(a) This Agreement and the Rights established hereby will terminate in all respects immediately
prior to the Effective Time (as such term is defined in the Merger Agreement). The Company hereby agrees to promptly notify the Rights Agent, in writing, upon the occurrence of the Effective Time, which notice shall specify (i)&nbsp;that the
Effective Time has occurred, and (ii)&nbsp;the date upon which this Agreement and the Rights established hereby were terminated. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">(b) The Rights Agent shall not be subject to, nor be required to comply with, or determine if any event has occurred under (including, but not limited to, the commencement or consummation of the Offer, the occurrence of the Merger or the
Effective Time), or any Person has complied with, the Merger Agreement or any agreements and documents related to or referred to in the Merger Agreement or any other agreement between or among the parties thereto, even though reference thereto may
be made in this Agreement, or to comply with any notice, instruction, direction, request or other communication, paper or document other than as expressly set forth in this Agreement.&#148; </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Section 2. <U>Interpretation</U>. The term &#147;Agreement&#148; as used in the Rights Agreement shall be deemed to refer to the Rights Agreement as
amended hereby. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Section 3. <U>Effectiveness; No Other Effect</U>. This Amendment shall be effective as of the date hereof and, except as
set forth herein, the Rights Agreement shall not otherwise be supplemented or amended by virtue of this Amendment, but shall remain in full force and effect as amended hereby. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">4 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Section 4. <U>Governing Law</U>. This Amendment shall be deemed to be a contract made under the laws of
the State of Delaware and for all purposes shall be governed by and construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of such State applicable to contracts to be made and performed entirely within such State. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Section 5. <U>Counterparts</U>. This Amendment may be executed in any number of counterparts and each of such counterparts shall for all purposes be
deemed to be an original, and all such counterparts shall together constitute but one and the same instrument. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Section 6. <U>If Merger
Abandoned</U>. If the Merger Agreement is terminated and the Offer and/or the Merger is abandoned, then from and after such time this Amendment shall be of no further force and effect and the Agreement shall remain exactly the same as it existed
immediately prior to execution of this Amendment. The Company hereby agrees to promptly notify the Rights Agent, in writing, upon the occurrence of the Merger Agreement being terminated and the Offer or the Merger being abandoned. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">[<I>Signature page follows</I>] </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">5 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Company and the Rights Agent have caused this Amendment to be duly executed as of
the day and year first above written. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P><DIV ALIGN="right">
